## Before you upgrade

- **The Docker quick start runs the newest release.** Up to 0.3.1 it ran the image built from `main`, so a new install got unreleased code. It now runs the release named in `deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml`, and `git pull` moves it to each new release. To keep running the newest build of `main`, put `SIGNALITH_VERSION=main` in `deploy/docker/.env` before you `git pull`; do so if you updated from `main` after 0.3.1 came out, since going back to an older version isn't supported. See [Running another version](https://github.com/jrsamsanchez/Signalith/blob/main/README.md#running-another-version-or-building-the-image-yourself).
